lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-grid pattern posterior to the pectoral fin attachment. High-intensity maxima are aligned in horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like array of luminance nodes across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-luminance spot pattern on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin; presence of a yellow-pigmented organism with vertical dark bands positioned adjacent to the lateral flank.
